description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of November 2016 being 116.6, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of December, 2016 will be Rs. 662.64
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific agricultural trades, which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour and relates to wage adjustments based on cost of living indices, making it a public service administrative matter rather than a government structural/personnel change or any of the other specialized categories.
